summary: End-to-end testing of Real Estate Plot Expense Tracker. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests passed (plot calc validation, 404s, transactions CRUD, dashboard summary aggregations including Withdrawal exclusion, online/cash bucket math). Frontend: dashboard, navigation, create-plot live preview, plot creation, plot detail stats, add/delete transaction with totals refresh all working.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI on_event('shutdown') — consider lifespan handler.
list_plots aggregates per-plot via N+1 queries (one find per plot). Fine for small lists, but consider a single $group aggregation as data grows.
CORS allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' is permissive; tighten in production.
Pydantic Literal validation returns 422 for bad bank/mode/type — good. No body sanitisation on `person`/`notes` (likely fine for this app).
seed_data_creation: Test plots/txns prefixed with TEST_ are auto-cleaned by pytest fixture teardown. One frontend e2e plot (TEST_E2E_Plot) may remain in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers: plot auto-calc (1500/3500/2800/7%/50000 → final 5,667,500), 404 on bad plot id, txn invalid plot/literal, txn list sort desc, total_paid excludes Withdrawal, dashboard online_total = Online+UPI, cash_total = Cash+ATM Withdrawal. Frontend currency uses Indian numbering (1,00,000). plot-card-0 visibility is timing-dependent on dashboard load — wait ~1s after navigation.
